thread.title: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP: Final Member Selection Match • Shin Tennis no Ouji-sama: U-17 WORLD CUP Kesshou Member Kettei-sen - Episode 2 discussion

opinions.point: Several viewers disliked the frequent rotating CGI court shots, describing them as excessive and sometimes uncomfortable to watch.
Some commenters enjoyed the series’ over-the-top style and were enthusiastic about the characters and upcoming matches.
One viewer appreciated that multiple matches moved forward but questioned some competitive decisions and still found parts of the cast’s abilities overly exaggerated.
A commenter particularly praised Fuji’s distinctive playing style.
A long-time fan was pleased that the series had returned and was considering watching weekly or bingeing later.

title: Tantei wa mou, Shindeiru. Season 2

thread.title: The Detective is Already Dead Season 2 • Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2 - Episode 1 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters remain strongly dissatisfied with the series’ writing and regard the adaptation as confusing, poorly structured, or undeserving of another season.
Some viewers were surprised that the episode was more tolerable than expected, while still carrying skepticism from season 1.
Light-novel readers and existing fans expressed hope for the season and continued interest in the cast.
Some reactions focused on weak or unappealing characterization, with commenters feeling that only a small part of the cast is compelling.
